high_level_description: The image features a large, illuminated Apple logo mounted on the exterior of an Apple Store. The logo is prominently displayed against a dark, wooden-textured wall, which adds a modern and sleek aesthetic to the scene. The logo itself is white with a black outline, creating a striking contrast. Below the logo, there is a caption in white text that reads: "Apple loses $115 billion in market value as regulators close in." This text suggests a significant financial impact on Apple due to regulatory actions or investigations.
